global_issues.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits Highest Since 2002
global_issues.note: Yields peaked around Sept 29-30 and then retreated from multiyear highs. The 10Y closed near 5.18% and the 30Y near 5.57% on Oct 2, after a weak September jobs report. The 'highest since 2002' wording was not independently confirmed. Rate-hike odds for October fell to about 23%, so the pressure from yields has eased.

global_issues.title: Oil Surges Over 4% on Middle East Risks and China Export Halt
global_issues.note: The Oct 1 surge is no longer the current state. WTI fell 3.66% on Oct 2 to about $89.41. I could not verify the third-carrier and China fuel-export-halt details.

grok_report.summary: The briefing reflected Oct 1 conditions accurately enough but is now stale. Yields retreated, oil fell about 3.7% on Oct 2, and a weak jobs report lifted stocks while cutting Fed hike odds. The jobs report is the major omission, and the mood, sector and rate-headwind narratives need updating.
